due.title: Filing & payment deadline
due.desc: Two months from the end of the month of sale (earlier of balance payment or registration). High-value homes over ₩1.2B must file even if partly exempt.
due.penalty: Late filing adds a 20% (40% if fraudulent) penalty plus 0.022% per day late payment. Local income tax is filed separately on Wetax.

sim.assume: Same sale price, later sale date (2028 deduction reform under review not applied)
sim.assumeLive: Same sale price, assuming you keep living there (2028 deduction reform under review not applied)
sim.none: Waiting up to 16 years does not lower the tax.

proposal.title: If the 2026 tax reform bill passes (under review)
proposal.desc: From filings on or after 2027-01-01, the surcharge on adjusted-area homes held 2+ years drops to +5%p (2 houses) / +10%p (3+), then +10/15%p in 2028 and back in 2029. Same case: about ₩{v}, ₩{d} less (deduction exclusion assumed to remain).

guide.lthdNote: The 1-house rate (holding + residence, up to 80%) applies to homes over ₩1.2B held 3+ and lived in 2+ years; otherwise the general rate (up to 30%). No deduction for surcharged homes or pre-sale rights.
guide.shortTitle: Rates by holding period and asset (Income Tax Act Art. 104)
guide.shortNote: When two rates apply, the higher tax wins. Unregistered transfers: 70%. Local income tax of 10% is added.

items.a: Within two months from the end of the month of sale (earlier of balance payment or registration). E.g. a March 15 closing is due May 31 (next business day if a holiday). Multiple sales in a year are combined in the May final return.

The household owns only one home on the sale date and has held it 2+ years; 2 years of residence are also required if it was in an adjusted area when bought (after 2017-08-03). Up to ₩1.2B fully exempt; above that only (price − ₩1.2B) / price of the gain is taxed.

items.q: I briefly own two homes while moving. What is the deadline?
items.a: Buy the new home at least 1 year after the old one and sell the old home within 3 years of buying the new one. Since 2026-10-01 it is 2 years if both homes are in adjusted areas and the new home was acquired on or after 2026-08-04 (contracts by 2026-08-03 keep 3 years).

items.q: Is the multi-home surcharge applied now?
items.a: Yes. The deferral ended on 2026-05-09, so from 05-10 adjusted-area sales get +20%p (2 houses) or +30%p (3+) and no long-term deduction. Contracts signed by 05-09 and closed within 4 or 6 months (in land-permit zones: permit applied for by 05-09) are excepted. The 2026 reform bill proposes temporary relief for 2027–2028 but has not passed.
Acquisition tax, brokerage, legal fees and capital improvements such as window frames, balcony extension or built-in AC. Repairs like wallpaper, flooring or boiler fixes do not count. Keep receipts.
Owners of a 1-house-exempt home over ₩1.2B held 3+ and lived in 2+ years: 4% per year held (max 40%) + 4% per year lived (8% for 2–3 years, max 40%).

items.q: How is the holding period counted?
items.a: From acquisition (earlier of balance payment or registration) to sale. Selling on the same date 2 years later counts as 2 years. Inherited homes count from the decedent's purchase for rate purposes; gifted homes from the gift registration.
Each owner is taxed separately. Split prices and expenses by share and calculate each. Each owner also gets the ₩2.5M basic deduction.

capitalGainsTax.guideTitle: How Capital Gains Tax is Calculated
guideSteps: Gain = sale price − acquisition price − expenses
1-house exemption: fully exempt up to ₩1.2B, otherwise only (price − ₩1.2B)/price is taxed
Long-term holding deduction for 3+ years (not for surcharged homes or pre-sale rights)
Gain income − ₩2.5M basic deduction = tax base
Tax base × rate − progressive deduction = tax (highest of basic, short-term, surcharge)
guideExemptItems: The household owns one domestic home on the sale date (temporary 2-house etc. included)
Held 2+ years — from the same date 2 years after purchase
2+ years of residence if in an adjusted area when bought (after 2017-08-03)
Fully exempt up to ₩1.2B, otherwise the excess ratio is taxed
All of Seoul + 12 Gyeonggi areas became adjusted on 2025-10-16 — later purchases need residence
